title: Red Velvet Cupcakes
author: Hannah Gunderman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbh7ij9n

steps.title: Prepare Oven and Pan
steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F and line a cupcake pan with cupcake liners.

steps.title: Prepare Vegan Buttermilk
steps.instruction: Mix 3/4 cup almond milk and 1 tsp apple cider vinegar and set aside for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Combine Wet Ingredients
steps.instruction: Add 1/3 cup melted and cooled coconut oil and 1 tsp vanilla extract to the almond milk mixture.

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.instruction: Mix the following dry ingredients together in a bowl: 1 cup Spelt flour (or regular flour, or gluten-free flour blend), 3/4 cup organic sugar, 2 tbsp cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3/4 tsp baking soda, and 1/4 tsp salt.

steps.title: Combine Batter
steps.instruction: Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix together until smooth.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 tsp beetroot powder or vegan red food colouring if using.

steps.title: Fill Pan and Bake
steps.instruction: Spoon the batter into the pan, filling 3/4 of the way full, and bake for 17-19 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

steps.title: Prepare Frosting Base
steps.instruction: Prepare the coconut cream base for the frosting.

substeps.instruction: If using a can of full-fat coconut milk: remove from fridge and scoop out only the cream on top.
Alternatively, use 2 cups store-bought coconut whipped cream.

steps.title: Whip Frosting
steps.instruction: Add 1 tsp vanilla extract and 4 tbsp organic sugar to the coconut cream and whip on high until smooth and soft peaks form.

steps.title: Finalize Frosting
steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup vegan cream cheese and continue to whip just until combined.

steps.title: Frost Cupcakes
steps.instruction: Use a piping bag to pipe the frosting onto the cupcakes.
